verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CIPO publishes an online sign-in entry ('Log in to MyCIPO Patents') and online trademark filing services. Nothing in the pack describes how that sign-in works: there is no mention of credential-based MFA, and nothing confirming or ruling out biometric liveness, in-person verification, or a PIN sent by mail. The axis applies to a government online-filing portal, but the specific capability this story asks about is unevidenced.
